title: Retrieve one published article through a versioned JSON contract
description:
Design-only planning requested by Ryan during voice. Implementation remains unstarted; no code, infrastructure, deployment, purchase or publishing authorization is implied. Initial status stays open (Discovery), unassigned.

As a application developer, I want a documented minimal article representation, so that I can render content independently of Papyrus pages.

Acceptance behavior (planned, not executable or verified yet):
```gherkin
Feature: Retrieve one published article through a versioned JSON contract
  Scenario: Retrieve a published article
    Given a published article with structured editorial fields and a Markus body
    When I request it through the v1 delivery contract
    Then I receive its contract version, stable identity, canonical URL, title, section, byline and publication/update timestamps
    And I receive its summary or deck when present and its body as a Markus string
    And optional fields and unknown-item behavior are documented
  Scenario: Request an unpublished identity
    Given an identity exists only as a draft or has been withdrawn
    When I request it through public delivery
    Then no article body, private fields or existence-sensitive editorial details are returned
```

Field spellings, exact route shape and version negotiation are design decisions to specify before implementation. Do not expose raw Item or unrestricted PublishedItem metadata; no exact Contentful compatibility commitment.
